questions.title: От сигнала к поручению
external_inputs: Exact permitted signal/report/participant receipt and its source/use rights; testimony also needs actual context, selection/translation and audience.
Actual sponsor/institution commission naming decision, scope, purpose, accountable principal, audience and answerers.
questions.unresolved_research: Standing/commission rules vary by jurisdiction. The pilot institution supplies issuer/delegation/review route; no universal rule is invented.

questions.title: Оспаривание выбранной области
external_inputs: Actual commission and, where relied upon, authenticated delegation, issuer competence, scope, effective/revocation dates and sponsor successor-selection act. A new institution act is needed only when existing resolved authority does not cover the changed scope.
Relevant legal/empirical/participatory sources and permissions; external principal authorized to accept any uncovered boundary change.
questions.unresolved_research: Standing to file/decide is institution- and jurisdiction-specific; retain candidate dissent while the selected institution resolves it.

questions.title: Идентичность и кратность дел
external_inputs: No external subject identifier is required to create/use the qualified local technical ref for PolicyOS custody and case-scoped work.

Issuer/assignment-system facts and actual referent are inputs only when an external alias or continuity claim is used; profile-local relation/cardinality and linkage error costs remain selected-context inputs, not global defaults.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal owner, issuer, schema, cardinality or method for cross-profile subject relations is ratified. Use the local technical ref now; keep external aliases and any real-world continuity claim source-qualified and unresolved until the relevant institution supplies grounds.

questions.title: Наследование оснований между делами
external_inputs: Parent commission and any relied-upon delegation: issuer, authenticity, scope, effectivity/revocation and sponsor selection. New act only if coverage is insufficient.
Child-use rights and selected source-specific method/target facts.
questions.unresolved_research: Delegation/standing is institution-specific. Resolve supplied evidence against exact scope; only uncovered protected uses wait. SDD concerns whether a link itself transfers admissibility, not the local-ref engineering.

questions.title: Что сохраняет смысл после split/merge онтологии?
external_inputs: Versioned source definitions and official split/merge relationships.
Variable-specific child data/margins/weights.
Selected method and measurement bridge evidence.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal equivalence threshold; test bridge/invariance per construct and method. Current path is branch, bound or retain parent scope.

questions.title: Когда спорная связка меняет целевую совокупность?
external_inputs: Linkage custodian’s candidates, model/calibration and complete target denominator.
Error/missingness by material strata; otherwise not_established.
Competent ruling only for legal membership.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal match threshold/fanout cap; choose method/workload budget, report diagnostics/unresolved mass, else limit completeness/support.

questions.title: Как сделать периоды разных календарей сопоставимыми?
external_inputs: Authoritative effective date with precision/jurisdiction.
Source calendar, periods, zone rules and native events.
Selected method’s time zero, lag and observation regime.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal time tolerance; use method requirements and source-supported neighboring windows. Without finer inputs, retain aggregate claim or conditional limitation.

questions.title: Когда агрегат поддерживает более мелкий target?
external_inputs: Actual aggregates and subgroup denominators/margins.
Variable-specific crosswalk/auxiliary evidence.
Causal design if effect, not descriptive association, is claimed.
questions.unresolved_research: Bound informativeness is empirical per target/source. Use validated partial-ID where possible; otherwise report aggregate resolution.

questions.title: Когда поиск достаточен для заявленного охвата?
external_inputs: Case owner/method reviewer supplies target, eligibility rule and materiality.
Provider/custodian supplies index coverage/cut/access and permitted query/result terms; existing CAP-01 verifies disclosure/use.
Known items need scoped references and independent-route provenance; their representativeness remains unknown.
questions.unresolved_research: No method proves a seed set represents every policy domain. For high-consequence absence claims, a reviewer must judge which unsearched source/language could change the result; record and route that gap now, then acquire only where material.

questions.title: Когда похожие источники дают независимую поддержку?
external_inputs: Custodian supplies cohort/site/sample/control lineage, overlap/covariance and corrections; restricted data may stay local behind a verified aggregate.
Method owner supplies estimand, dependence assumptions, cluster adequacy and falsifier.
Sharing permission for any overlap witness is resolved externally through current rights.
questions.unresolved_research: No general algorithm proves disjointness when custodians hide lineage. Try registration and custodian-side overlap routes for a consequential replication claim; otherwise keep unknown dependence and retain scoped, non-independent findings.

questions.title: Когда качество основания ухудшилось без смены его версии?
external_inputs: Custodian supplies frame, eligibility, subgroup, missingness, attrition, weight and instrument/mode facts; source access remains permitted.
Method reviewer supplies target/estimand, effect modifiers, assumptions and falsifier; bridge data need lawful access.
Permitted custodian-side aggregates may substitute for raw rows. A webhook is not prerequisite for a qualified own assessment to affect dependent currentness.
questions.unresolved_research: Unmeasured/unreported drift cannot be detected without suitable observations. Check source-side audits, administrative benchmarks, follow-up or bridge studies for the case; absent these, retain last observed target/frame boundary with explicit uncertainty.

questions.title: Пересечение правопорядков и частичная применимость
external_inputs: Official source/status records and factual target/territory/action.
Named legal reviewer and selected conflict rule where sources contradict.
questions.unresolved_research: No actual jurisdiction/program is supplied. A concrete review must decide co-application vs conflict; no global resolver is justified.

questions.title: Конкурирующие толкования и их правовой вес
external_inputs: Authentic source/language and named reviewer mandate.
Actual decision plus evidence of jurisdiction/scope/status if claimed.
questions.unresolved_research: No legal system or actual competing ruling is supplied; effect of precedent must be resolved under the selected forum's rules. No actual holding is asserted.

questions.title: Оспаривание, приостановление и преюдициальный вопрос
external_inputs: Actual official order/docket/appeal/referral with scope/status.
Applicable procedural rule and service evidence where effect depends on notice.
questions.unresolved_research: Need the real proceeding, rule and order to resolve stay/finality. EU Article 267 is a bounded example, not evidence this hypothetical is stayed.

questions.title: Процедурные условия и распределённый мандат
external_inputs: Selected instrument/procedure law, actual issuer and any delegation.
Original notice, participation and approval records plus recipient/timing evidence.
Real participant/process custodian and mandate where relied on.
questions.unresolved_research: No act/procedure is supplied; a reviewer must map required steps and defect effects. Aarhus is a bounded environmental example only.

questions.title: Договор, обычай и мягкие нормы
external_inputs: Official depositary/issuer and domestic implementation record.
Practice/opinio-juris evidence with contrary examples for custom.
Actual contract/regulation/funding/mandate if soft law is said to bind.
questions.unresolved_research: No instrument, rule or incorporation is selected. A concrete legal reviewer must decide scope; architecture can represent the evidence and limitation without a universal force engine.

questions.title: Воздействие правового изменения на собственную подпись
external_inputs: Official change act and saving/transition scope.
Qualified reviewer determination and exact claim/dependency/source cut.
questions.unresolved_research: No actual later law or signed claim is supplied. Resolve its effect against the exact source dependency and affected audience; preserve both views until then.

questions.title: Что утверждает рекомендация при несовместимых мандатах?
external_inputs: For a conditional calculation: actual selected schedule/assumption provenance, data/model/method, rights, currentness and comparison scope. A principal mandate is needed only to claim that principal's authorized choice; a collective act covering groups/audience/objective/aggregation/time is needed only for a collective-welfare selection or endorsement.
questions.unresolved_research: If a local procedure (including vote) is invoked to select or endorse collectively, resolve its legal authority/scope with the competent institution. Until then, do not state a collective winner; implementation can still publish the independently grounded conditional comparison. Product/runtime reachability remains UNRUN.

questions.title: На чём основана граница затронутых групп?
external_inputs: Source-backed population/geography/time and direct/indirect/cumulative mechanisms.
questions.unresolved_research: No advance proof excludes every future group. Use domain evidence/monitoring and retain residual unknowns.

questions.title: Когда позиция группы зависит от процесса обсуждения?
external_inputs: Actual process custodian, remit, script/options, facilitator/sponsor, translation, participant selection and deviations.
questions.unresolved_research: Stability/manipulation are empirical and process-specific; without control report observed views only.

questions.title: Как интерес участника влияет на пригодность его суждения?
external_inputs: Interest declarations and evidence of role/source-selection activity, with updates.
questions.unresolved_research: Materiality/disclosure thresholds vary by institution; absent a rule, report role-specific limitation, no trust score.

questions.title: Что происходит при конфликте разрешений?
external_inputs: Source custodian and actual law/agreements/community protocol or authorized resolver.
questions.unresolved_research: Secondary-use authority depends on source, jurisdiction and derivative; resolve with actual parties.

questions.title: Нечисловые основания при неидентифицируемом эффекте
external_inputs: Original records, case-selection frame, source/time and author competence.
Separate estimand/study if an average effect is requested.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal numeric threshold for qualitative causal warrant; CNT-06 can require explicit method, rivals and scope.

questions.title: Переход от кандидата к структурному изменению модели
external_inputs: Case-selected source/data provenance, applicable data/conduct permission and actual returned evidence or regime/measurement bridge facts where externally held. Discriminator selection and study design are DES-12 internal work; sufficiently qualified existing evidence may avoid a new study.
questions.unresolved_research: Best feasible discriminator is setting-specific; DES-12 can optimize over declared rivals without asserting completeness.

questions.title: Неизвестные связи вне сохранённого множества моделей
external_inputs: Domain-informed omitted-cause challenge set and empirical detection coverage for any exclusion.
questions.unresolved_research: Completeness is generally not provable globally; implement explicit set, missing-structure limits and justified bounds now.

questions.title: Один конструкт или смена измерительного режима
external_inputs: Instrument/code history, overlap validation, relevant subgroups/language, policy-linked reporting incentives.
questions.unresolved_research: Bridge adequacy is empirical; store tests and preserve split regime output when it is unknown.

questions.title: Селективно отсутствующие результаты исследований
external_inputs: Registry/protocol/SAP/results, retrieval responses, eligibility/cutoff and outcome range if bounding.
questions.unresolved_research: Selection probabilities and unregistered studies are generally not identified from published outcomes alone; matrix, ROB-ME and scenarios remain useful.

questions.title: Разная точность внутри спорного множества моделей
external_inputs: Source-qualified required model set, method guarantees, dependence/coupling and validity domain
Grounds for required branches and authorized target/population/constraints
Declared family confidence/error budget; no optimizer-supplied model prior
questions.unresolved_research: No universal joint rule spans methods. Use profile-valid finite-family alpha allocation/union bound or dependence-aware procedure; adaptive looks need time-uniform coverage or correction. Postselected/uncovered cells stay limited.

questions.title: Объяснение сдвига при одновременном обновлении данных и модели
external_inputs: Custodian corrections/cuts/retention rights
Authorized goal/value/mandate basis for ranking
Lawful availability of historical executable and inputs
questions.unresolved_research: Some hybrid factor subsets are invalid/incomparable and exact cost is 2^k per branch. The chosen game and uncertainty remain case-specific; verify sum_i φ_i=direct delta and never sum a separate interaction contrast as another allocation.

questions.title: Граница поиска при конкурирующих постановках
external_inputs: Exact request/selection; mandate or common values only for claims that require them.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal common basis for cross-frame ranking; keep separate frontiers until a competent owner supplies one.

questions.title: Адекватность описателей для поиска невидимых механизмов
external_inputs: Actual case decision need/affected-group constraints and independent bounded labels; hypothetical ideas need no external fact to remain candidates.
questions.unresolved_research: Universal descriptor completeness is unprovable; keep expanding case-specific views and state remaining scope as not established.

questions.title: Расходование бюджета между качеством, неопределённостью и предпочтениями
external_inputs: Authorized candidate profile/budget if autonomous allocation is desired.
External study/data permission only for acquisition execution.
Value owner only for normative choice.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal exchange rate across outcomes, compute, attention, acquisition and rights. Operational profile can allocate candidate compute; normative outcomes stay set-valued until an authorized owner decides.

questions.title: Остановка поиска без ложного вывода об отсутствии меры
external_inputs: Need/no-op basis or authorized threshold only if required; candidate profile/budget if used; provider rights only for dependent routes.
questions.unresolved_research: Stopping thresholds are case/method-specific; test them on frozen cases and claim only that protocol, not universal exhaustion.

questions.title: Зависимость frontier от порядка и истории поиска
external_inputs: Case/mechanism rationale for a predeclared pair.
Provider/retention and memory-transfer rights when varied.
Competent semantic case labels.
questions.unresolved_research: Repeat count/materiality are case-specific. Predeclare plausible interaction pairs; otherwise report main effects only. Untested/higher-order behavior stays not established.

questions.title: Комиссия, разрешение на conduct и права данных
external_inputs: Commission/award/acceptance and partial scope from sponsor/commissioner when the study is commissioned; do not require this act for unrelated secondary analysis.
Applicable protocol-specific ethics/regulatory/site/investigator approvals and corrections from competent external actors.
Current source custodian rights for the actual action (read/analyze/derive/export/publish), purpose, recipient and retention; analyze and derive rights are not inferred from read access.
Actual conduct/deviation/result record from investigator/site.
questions.unresolved_research: No single legal form or competent actor applies across selected jurisdictions and research types. Preserve the exact external requirement per case; do not invent it.

questions.title: Граница подтверждающего вывода при отклонении
external_inputs: Exact protocol/SAP editions, approval/amendment and investigator/site deviation history.
First access to interim outcomes, actual looks/stopping, assignment/receipt and sample/site drops.
Selected claim-type estimator, assumptions and operating-characteristic basis.
questions.unresolved_research: There is no universal statistical downgrade for all deviations; novel method-specific consequences stay limited until the selected method owner supplies assumptions and falsifier.

questions.title: Нет результата, нулевой эффект и незавершённое исследование
external_inputs: Registry/protocol outcomes, actual sample/measurement denominator and investigator stop/missingness explanation if known.
Method for informative stopping/missingness and current-use rights.
Conditional equivalence needs a fitting method and prespecified/source-grounded or explicit hypothetical margin; policy-value claim needs authorized decision-value basis.
questions.unresolved_research: Inference from safety/futility stopping or informative missingness depends on the actual design and generating process; without sufficient source/method evidence, retain limited or inconclusive result.

questions.title: Портфель исследований и общие ресурсы
external_inputs: Decision alternatives/utility and target/horizon; authorization is needed for policy-value claims, not labeled hypothetical calculation.
Study prior/uncertainty, observation/missingness law, overlap and source rights.
Cost/time/opportunity-cost for net/ENBS or cost-based rank; state whether delay is in utility.
Sourced operator/site/cohort/team/instrument/window capacity for feasibility or constrained rank.
questions.unresolved_research: Values/probabilities, burden and capacity are case-specific. Without qualified inputs, show conditional scenarios/partial order and the unsupported net, ranking or feasibility claim; invent no scalar.

questions.title: Полнота внешнего набора study–report–outcome
external_inputs: Selected source roster, exact search protocol/cutoff and access state.
Registry/sponsor/custodian/publisher identifiers, versions, protocol links, corrections and outcome data.
Cohort/sample/report ancestry when independence or dependence matters.
Current action-specific rights for read/analyze/derive/export/publish at the intended purpose and audience; publication right remains separate.
questions.unresolved_research: Unregistered/unindexed sources remain outside the bounded corpus unless a case-specific source/holder supplies them. Unknown overlap or unpublished outcome limits synthesis; do not claim universal completeness.

questions.title: Граница видимости мониторинга
external_inputs: Actual outcome labels, eligibility/reporting, source receipts and rollout facts come from custodians; PolicyOS admits/reconciles, not invents.
An external study needs protocol-specific permission, conduct and returned evidence; synthetic scenarios witness mechanism only.
questions.unresolved_research: No finite monitor establishes sensitivity to an open-ended universe of unregistered variables/mechanisms from its own stream. Select a decision-relevant alternative set and method-specific analysis; unresolved cases remain limitations. No universal threshold.

questions.title: Перенос отрицательного знания
external_inputs: Executed outcomes, source/target measures, exposure/selection and reuse rights come from actual owners; memory cannot manufacture them.
Causal graph/selection assumptions need claim-specific judgment. Without defensible transport/invariance, keep result local and search-useful.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal criterion transports negative mechanism knowledge across domains. Choose method per causal structure; source-only null cannot settle unmeasured target mechanisms. Preserve the local result and route a distinguishing study without blocking unrelated candidates.

questions.title: Связать свежесть модели с текущим допуском профиля
external_inputs: Provider request/response ID, served model/route/region/version when exposed; missing metadata remains not_established.
Source-qualified release/remap/retirement/incident notice and scope if actually available; missing feed is not a no-change receipt.
Independent profile cases/oracles, authorized thresholds/window and permitted access/cost from existing evaluation, governance and egress owners.
unresolved_research: Opaque service cannot reveal hidden snapshot or exact drift onset; probes bound observed behavior, not absence of unobserved change.
Silent-update frequency and rare-error sample power are unknown; measure miss/false-alert/cost per profile. Until then use bounded candidate path and limit production claims to tested strata.

questions.title: Когда можно утверждать, что читатель понял
external_inputs: Commissioned audience/frame and participant access
Independent oracle and institution-supplied work/support context
questions.unresolved_research: INT-R3 needs owner-approved frame completeness/precision; no universal sample size or cutoff.

questions.title: Осознанное согласие или автоматизационное смещение
external_inputs: Selected participants and actual model profile where claimed
Independent correctness labels
questions.unresolved_research: Advice effects and cognitive burden remain empirical for each selected task/profile/audience. Estimate first-decision and revision effects separately; repeated-exposure carryover may be bounded by parallel arms or reported as a limitation. No universal interaction, sample size or cutoff.

questions.title: Смысловое согласование параллельных редакций
external_inputs: Edited carrier/rights
Native dependency map; human mapping for material ambiguity
questions.unresolved_research: No universal merge rule; owners define relations that can change their conclusions.

questions.title: Смысл статусов в переводе и доступных представлениях
external_inputs: Selected locale/carrier
Qualified target readers and accessibility evaluator
questions.unresolved_research: Comprehension and accessibility remain unmeasured for untested audience/locale/carrier combinations; no standard provides a universal semantic threshold. Apply claims only to actual selected renditions.

questions.title: Понимание реакции на исправление или несогласие
external_inputs: Actual correction/act and permission where claimed
Native claim owner and valid affected-claim link
questions.unresolved_research: Reader understanding under real response delays remains empirical. External adjudication and issuer decisions remain external; the system can immediately limit only its own affected current claims through LIF-02.

questions.title: Различение неизвестного и скрытого по правам
external_inputs: Audience-specific access decision
Source denominator for known zero and applicable rights
questions.unresolved_research: Protected existence must remain indistinguishable only on audiences/surfaces where rights require it. Exact route/cache behavior depends on the commissioned deployment; enumerate and test that selected closure, leave unselected routes out_of_scope, and do not claim universal absence or internet-wide recall.

questions.title: Доверие к производителям и внутренним ролям
external_inputs: Bound source/provider and build record
Competent source/issuer grounds only for factual or authority claims
Independent evidence only when independent corroboration is claimed
Competent trust-root succession evidence
questions.unresolved_research: Trust-root independence is profile-specific; absent proof limits that claim, not a valid local recomputation.

questions.title: Дефект или компрометация производителя: какие claims затронуты?
external_inputs: Incident report and pinned defect repro
Invocation/version/descendant coverage
Changed claim, corrected basis, expected head and issuer admission when reissue applies
questions.unresolved_research: Unknown execution coverage limits dependent impact even when the local defect is established.

questions.title: Накопительное раскрытие через запросы и модели
external_inputs: Current source-authorized rule and issuer, including operations, unit, purpose, recipients, cumulative rule and effective version
Source-defined unit and alias/overlap relation
Valid DP mechanism/adjacency only for formal DP claim
Actual call/output receipts and recipient set
questions.unresolved_research: Auxiliary data and future queries prevent finite probes from proving no leakage. Missing policy or complete state limits dependent protected/public release without inventing a threshold.

questions.title: Consent, производное использование и отзыв
external_inputs: Competent person/community/source issuer and notice version
Applicable jurisdiction, lawful basis and retention exception
Provider or recipient evidence of release/deletion/retraining
questions.unresolved_research: A prior release, third-party retention and exact model influence can be partly unobservable; state measured coverage, not universal erasure.

questions.title: Злоупотребление рекомендацией после adoption
external_inputs: Adopter/recipient/affected person or regulator evidence
Exact recommendation edition and actual audience/use
Applicable external authority or rule defining the boundary
questions.unresolved_research: Post-adoption activity may be unobservable and complaints incomplete; no report never proves all uses remained in scope.

questions.title: Преемственность единицы при split/merge
external_inputs: Source data dictionary and lifecycle events with content/version.
Legal act only if legal continuity is in scope.
Selected method’s unit, cohort and windows.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal entity continuity rule; preserve episodes/candidate relations, branch on source evidence, then re-evaluate selected method.

questions.title: Согласованность срезов независимых источников
external_inputs: Native snapshot/cursor semantics, coverage and continuity evidence per source.
Change/correction event effective and known-at times.
Selected estimand’s ordering, lag and completeness requirements.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal tolerance; source-supported sensitivity gives only conditional evidence and cannot prove unobserved revisions absent. If continuity contract is missing, preserve as-of bound or currentness not_established; candidate analysis can continue.

questions.title: Как распределять дефицитную мощность между обязанностями?
external_inputs: Service owner: profile, authenticated principal/parent-org, aggregation, enforceable classes/fairness inputs.
Custody owner: competent duty owner, scope/cadence/due/urgency and bounded coverage/cutoff.
Provider owner: OPS-07 charge evidence if monetary cost is claimed.
questions.unresolved_research: No literature sets normative priority or finite wait under sustained overload. Owners choose scope/capacity/cutoff; PolicyOS can refuse new duty with measured gap while candidate work continues.

questions.title: Какие часы определяют lease и просрочку worker?
external_inputs: Backend owner: clock, hosts, restore path and durable generation semantics.
Provider: receiver fence or idempotency/reconciliation contract.
Custody owner: due interpretation/source/uncertainty/cadence/cutoff and dependent-claim enrollment.
questions.unresolved_research: Qualify actual backend/restore path and sink before fencing claims. Without proof, refuse protected resume and preserve indeterminate state; unknown due affects enrolled claims only. No universal clock needed.

questions.title: Состав совместимого выпуска
external_inputs: Upstream compatibility обещания и фактические resolved model/plugin/connector версии.
Реально оставленные reader/writer/artifacts и выбранный профиль.
questions.unresolved_research: Универсального окна версий не обосновано. После E02 rebind посчитать только actual retained versions selected profile и проверить operation-specific cross-owner pairs; полнота hidden provider/build inputs остаётся bounded limitation.

questions.title: Окно смешанных версий
external_inputs: Operators disclose active processes and chosen deployment semantics.
Provider supplies idempotency/lookup/cancel window; service owner supplies restore target.
questions.unresolved_research: Actual overlap duration depends on selected target and live attempts; determine with one selected transition after rebind, not a default duration.

questions.title: Фактическая идентичность установленного стека
external_inputs: Trusted builder root/host measurement and actual per-cell operator inventory.
Provider supplies resolved model id when available; hidden weights may remain unknown.
questions.unresolved_research: Static typed attestation building block is not evidence of a full OPS-03 readback chain. Verify selected profile after E02; no live cells/product claims inspected.

questions.title: Вывод сторонних моделей, коннекторов и расширений
external_inputs: Supplier/account notice, support terms and exact applicable product versions.
Component owner assesses semantic/security reachability.
questions.unresolved_research: Provider notice completeness varies. For selected vendor establish actual endpoint/cursor/account coverage; otherwise report unknown, not blanket monitoring.

questions.title: Срочный security patch
external_inputs: Supplier/CERT provides verified affected range; OPS-01 record supplies currently effective delegated actions/scope/audience/expiry.
Security/release owner supplies urgency and patch choice only within that grant; unknown authority limits broader action.
Offline operator supplies local import/freshness evidence.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal severity→deadline conversion. Where exact impact or inventory unknown, limit that scope; no unsafe rollback or all-system stop by default.

questions.title: Повторная приёмка после обновления
external_inputs: Institution defines delegated release changes and authority reapproval scope.
Each selected site/cloud/offline owner confirms actual rollout/targets and local custody facts.
questions.unresolved_research: Whether a change requires renewed approval depends on selected grant, legal scope and operator delegation; no universal per-version rule. Material external-boundary changes go to competent owner.

questions.title: Разбор пограничного расширения по существующим критериям
external_inputs: Для expert-identified obligation — конкретный экспертный counterexample и reviewer только в объёме существующего owner contract.
questions.unresolved_research: Различающий кейс для нового primitive должен показать, что существующие facets/compositions не выражают повторяющийся спрос; универсальная novelty-метрика не нужна.

questions.title: Сочетание конфликтующих расширений
external_inputs: Нужны определения источника/consumer и, при споре, evidence владельца о units/population/effective scope; внешний legal act нужен только для правового вопроса.
questions.unresolved_research: На конкретном pair могут остаться эмпирические relation/consumer tests; до них сохранять направленные альтернативы, а не вводить общий resolver.

questions.title: Доверие к внешним авторам и верификаторам
external_inputs: Provide method/data evidence. If review is relied on, resolve scope-relevant expertise and any required independence evidence under the native owner contract. Official appointment is needed only when that contract/legal rule requires it.
questions.unresolved_research: The native method owner must state what evidence qualifies a reviewer for this predicate and whether independence is required. Without it, review is attributed/candidate; direct recomputation remains available.

questions.title: Смысловая совместимость между экземплярами и юрисдикциями
external_inputs: Источник поставляет authentic artifact/profile/rule and its own authority/time facts; receiver institution — local rule and official appointment/jurisdiction facts where required.
questions.unresolved_research: Для конкретной foreign/local pair определить mapping strength по definitions, boundary probes и selected use. До этого preserve provenance and independent facets; dependent claims remain limited.

questions.title: Как соотнести пользовательскую ценность с ценой проверки?
external_inputs: Scalar: authorized decision-specific outcome/weights.
Numeric EVSI: qualified priors/result; otherwise не заявлять.
questions.unresolved_research: Пользовательский outcome и loss basis специфичны decision owner; сейчас доступны set-valued delta и measured cost, не универсальный порог.

questions.title: Что означает полная стоимость claim на всём сроке?
external_inputs: Версионированная finance policy для shared overhead; иначе unallocated.
Recorded review hours; money rate только по institutional convention.
Retention/reuse rights и evidence of successor acceptance.
questions.unresolved_research: У shared overhead нет универсального причинного split; D08-06 остается purpose-specific, без универсального search utility. Сейчас показывать sourced direct actuals, unallocated balance и coverage.

questions.title: Когда внутреннее энергопотребление становится предметным фактором?
external_inputs: Selected ecological boundary and R.
Meter/model and provider boundary.
Source/version/region/time of I and method for M.
Authorized environmental value only if ranking outcomes.
questions.unresolved_research: Complete cloud energy/embodied allocation may be unavailable/model-dependent; report bounded scope and uncertainty. Cited Scope 2 status (2026-10-16) описывает еще не завершенное изменение.

questions.title: Когда несколько PolicyMatter становятся одним портфелем?
external_inputs: Если заявляется adoption: внешний акт, signer/mandate и resolved applicability/effectivity.
questions.unresolved_research: Универсального порога нет: проверить, decision-relevant ли edge для estimand; пока — отдельные результаты/conditional scenario.

questions.title: Когда самостоятельные дела конкурируют за одну мощность?
external_inputs: Resource/operational owners: supply, commitments, user scope, timing, uncertainty, substitutions.
questions.unresolved_research: Агрегация зависит от физических единиц; несводимая мощность требует bounded scenario, не scalar.

questions.title: Где проходят пределы вывода между юрисдикциями?
external_inputs: Receiver/exposure data; official boundaries, acts and competence from custodians.
questions.unresolved_research: Selected chain producer/method is unestablished pending rebind; not a repository-wide absence claim. CNT-06 qualifies but does not create receiver data.

questions.title: Как связать стратегический ответ на политику между делами?
external_inputs: Observed take-up/routing/measurement shifts; rule version/effective time; actor/program scope.
questions.unresolved_research: Equilibrium/selection market-specific: diagnostics и bounded alternatives; profile не выбирается по выгодному исходу.

questions.title: Какая граница действует при системном кризисе?
external_inputs: Time-stamped reconciled incident/sensor/service evidence, baseline calibration, affected scope and source events.
questions.unresolved_research: No universal discriminator: specify per system signature, false-positive sensitivity and counterexamples; else bounded stress analysis.

questions.title: Как сопоставлять горизонты портфеля без общей шкалы ценностей?
external_inputs: Long-run cohort/outcome evidence and applicable measure/aggregation-rule basis; normative selection additionally needs actual authorized value choices. Hypothetical version-bound weights remain declared assumptions, and future mechanisms remain uncertain.
questions.unresolved_research: Long-run extrapolation needs method-specific validation; until then report support plus bounds/scenario, no default annualization/discount.

questions.title: Кто задаёт валидную рубрику полезности без внешнего oracle?
external_inputs: Actual principal/audience and their authority to define policy-relevant need.
questions.unresolved_research: Reader sample and transfer are empirical; absent live audience evidence remains UNRUN.

questions.title: Что доказывает переход от рекомендации к реальному использованию?
external_inputs: Actual matter/body, target scope, audience and permitted use.
Competent instrument for adoption/effect; source-native operation/coverage for execution; feedback method only if outcome claimed.
Source custodian, rights, correction route and conflicting/late acts; missing inputs explicit.
questions.unresolved_research: Организация, система, кейс и channel не выбраны; CNT-01 должен сделать это до source adapter. Bounded candidate/limitation возможны сейчас.

questions.title: Как связать ручную передачу с исходной редакцией?
external_inputs: Actual permitted carrier/ref, parent edition, established provenance/time, rights and audience.
If claiming institutional use/adoption, actual source-native response/decision; export log/download is insufficient.
If the underlying PolicyOS claim is said to change, the admitted source event/qualified assessment and exact enrolled premise; the derivative alone is not that evidence.
questions.unresolved_research: No real carrier/route selected. DES-07 can represent supplied bytes and uncertainty; cannot establish unobserved copies or acknowledgements.

questions.title: Какая преемственность важна для работы учреждения?
external_inputs: Competent appointment/delegation source, effective date/remit if authority changes.
Operator capacity/coverage basis with units, target, period and planned/committed/measured/executed status if feasibility claimed.
Custodian and usage rights; absent facts leave feasibility conditional.
questions.unresolved_research: No organization, personnel, mandate or resource series selected; handoff impact is open. Claim-specific dependency can be built without institution-specific role model.

questions.title: Как трактовать вред и несогласие до разрешения спора?
external_inputs: Actual report/source, asserted occurrence/received time, affected claim/exposure scope, provenance and consent/rights.
Occurrence needs corroboration; causality needs selected method/denominator; adjudication needs competent body's exact outcome.
Contradictions/corrections and proceeding state where available; no result does not delay narrow reaction.
questions.unresolved_research: Harm domain, source completeness, wording, threshold and adjudicator unselected. Causality/remedy remain empirical/external; keep bounded limitation, no universal score.

questions.title: Приоритет при конфликте действующих правил
external_inputs: Если разрешение требует сведений о внешнем акте/мандате, принять только исходный authority evidence с issuer, subject, act, scope и актуальностью; сейчас такие факты не установлены.
questions.unresolved_research: Как именно текущий competent principal будет подтверждён при фактическом споре об идентичности — Q02, не выводится из текста S0. Действующий кодовый conflict resolver и status mapping нужно проверить после E02; сейчас не заявлены.

questions.title: Непрерывность полномочия human principal
external_inputs: If disputed, the recognized governance source must establish current-principal identity/legitimacy; no appointment/successor evidence appears in reviewed records.
questions.unresolved_research: Repository cannot settle external identity, delegation right or off-repo succession. No fallback office, quorum or successor.

questions.title: Переход открытого вопроса к решению или закрытию
external_inputs: G8 evidence refs; actual dated authorized decision for any normative/design choice. No authority is inferred from the vision document.
questions.unresolved_research: Empirical adequacy stays study-specific; measurements cannot settle normative schema choices. Preserve the remainder until authorized disposition.
